The cost varies between each Slayer master, with each master also having their own block list. Players can block the task as they obtain it, or they can block it straight from the "View List" option in the interface. Blocks will only be given for tasks that the player can access (indicated with a check mark); tasks that are not assigned, either due to not being toggled or players without the requirements cannot be blocked. This can also help players determine which tasks to block as each task has their own specific percentage of being assigned. Blocking a task that is currently in [[Task Storage]] does not also skip it. If you wish to block and skip an undesired task, you should unstore it first. There is a maximum limit of 7 types of assignments that can be blocked on one account - one block slot is given for every 50 quest points the player has. For most slayer masters - with [[Mortimer]] being the exception - there are six slots for a total of 300 points needed to use all of them. Additionally, one block slot is available once the player has completed the Elite tier of the [[Lumbridge & Draynor Diary]], which requires a [[quest cape]].
